tasks.title: Implement Hermes native skills install
tasks.description: Add a Hermes-specific install target for `mo skills install --hermes` that installs full packaged `mohist` and `mohist-explore` skill-data directories into `${HERMES_HOME:-~/.hermes}/skills/`. The implementation should preserve existing default, `--path`, and `--claude` behavior while avoiding Hermes config reads or writes.
acceptanceCriteria: Hermes installs use full `skill-data/` content and do not copy `stubs/` content
Only built-in `mohist` and `mohist-explore` are installed; user-defined skills such as `mohist-po` are not installed
Repeat installs replace the Mohist-managed target directories and report `updated`; first installs report `created`
The command prints Hermes-specific usage guidance for `/mohist` and `/mohist-explore`, including a reload/reset or new-session note
The command does not read or modify Hermes `config.yaml` or `skills.external_dirs`
Existing `mo skills install`, `mo skills install --path <repo>`, and `mo skills install --claude` behavior remains unchanged
Ambiguous target option combinations such as `--hermes --claude` or `--hermes --path` fail with a clear error
tasks.notes: Use `HERMES_HOME` for tests and implementation path resolution; default to `path.join(os.homedir(), '.hermes')` when unset.

tasks.title: Add Hermes installer regression tests
tasks.description: Add automated tests that verify the Hermes native install behavior end to end using a temporary `HERMES_HOME`. The tests should also protect existing OpenCode and Claude install behavior from regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify `HERMES_HOME` controls the Hermes install root and no real `~/.hermes` path is used
Tests verify full skill-data directories are copied recursively, including `mohist/references/issue-templates.md`
Tests verify Hermes-installed `SKILL.md` content is not the hidden stub content
Tests verify `mohist-po` and unrelated skill directories are not installed or modified
Tests verify first and repeated Hermes installs return or print `created` and `updated` results clearly
Tests verify `--path` and `--claude` installs still write to their existing targets and do not use the Hermes target
Tests verify incompatible option combinations fail clearly
tasks.notes: Prefer extending existing shared skill tests unless a focused Hermes test file makes the coverage clearer.
